jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will manage the full recruitment cycle while building strong relationships with both clients and candidates. You will combine business development, consulting, and talent acquisition to deliver successful recruitment solutions.

Client Details

Michael Page is a global leader in specialized recruitment, connecting top talent with leading companies across a wide range of industries. With a strong international presence and a people-focused culture, Michael Page offers a dynamic environment where ambition and career growth are encouraged.

Description

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment process.
• Develop and maintain a portfolio of clients.
• Source, interview, and assess qualified candidates.
• Build long-term relationships with clients and candidates.
• Provide recruitment advice and market insights.
• Negotiate offers and support placements.
• Contribute to business growth through commercial activities.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, customer-facing roles, or recruitment is a strong advantage.
• Commercial mindset with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Driven, resilient, and target-oriented.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Fluent in French & Dutch, French & English, or Dutch & English.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international, and performance-driven environment.

jobs.occupation: Manager Consolidation and Reporting - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Manager / Head of Consolidation & Group Reporting.

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

Key Responsibilities :

• Steer the monthly, quarterly and annual consolidation under IFRS
• Ensure quality and completeness of consolidated accounts (eliminations, minority interests, acquisitions/divestments…)
• Lead the preparation of the group's statutory financial statements and quarterly reporting
• Act as main point of contact for external auditors
• Manage and optimise the consolidation system (HFM or equivalent)
• Develop reporting structures, dashboards and closing-process improvements
• Support M&A activities (PPA, integration, system setup)
• Collaborate closely with FP&A, treasury and local accounting teams
• Possibility to manage one consolidation analyst (depending on experience).

• Master's degree in Finance/Accounting; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA…) is an asset
• 6-12 years of experience in Consolidation or External Audit within an international context
• Strong IFRS expertise and ability to handle complex accounting topics
• Rigorous, analytical and comfortable with tight deadlines
• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

jobs.occupation: International Inside Sales - High-Performance Metal Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Italian is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

jobs.occupation: Brand and Category Manager - FMCG - Confectionary company
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of well-established brands enjoyed by millions of consumers worldwide. Combining a rich heritage with a forward-thinking mindset, the company develops and markets high-quality products that are part of consumers' everyday lives.

With a significant international footprint, multiple production sites across several countries, and thousands of employees worldwide, the organization combines global scale with a strong local-market focus. Its success is driven by a deep understanding of consumer needs, continuous innovation, and a commitment to delivering products that consumers know, trust, and love.

The company offers a dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and contribute to the growth of iconic brands.

Jobomschrijving

The Brand & Category Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and driving the performance of the company's brands and product categories (sweet biscuits, chocolate, savoury).

This role leads the marketing strategy for the Belgium market, optimizes the product assortment, analyzes business performance, and ensures alignment between consumer needs, market trends, and business objectives, all while supporting the broader strategic vision of the group.Keys responsibilities and activities

Brand Management:

• Define and implement the annual marketing plan in terms of product portfolio, innovation, communication, consumer/shopper activation.
• Contribute to the preparation of the yearly marketing budget. Be responsible to follow up the spendings, making sure you stay aligned with the agreed yearly budget.
• Collaborate with the Netherlands, France, England and Turkey team on cross-border concepts, innovation launches. Recommend the relevant innovations and go-to market plan for Belgium market and prepare the launch plans.
• Manage the existing portfolio, including the potential updates driven by global teams and oversee the development of Point-of-Sale (POS) material.
• Implement the annual communication plan (social media, OOH and retail media campaigns).
• Implement and monitor the annual consumer/shopper activation's (consumer promotion, sampling, couponing campaign, Point Of Sale (POS) materials for field sale steam …)
• Analyse the activities results and take the conclusions into action plan and optimize investments and future strategies.
• Be in permanent contact with external agencies and internal stakeholders (production, logistics, finance, legal, marketing, new product development).
• Monitor and analyse brands and products performances.

Category Management:

• Analyse Categories to identify the growth drivers. Participate in key customer meetings to share the Category Perspective and insights.
• Analyse customer performances and shopper data to develop sharp sales argumentation for business review and customer presentations (Colruyt, Delhaize, Carrefour, Intermarché, HD).
• Guide and work closely with Sales teams to optimize brand plan execution.

• A bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in a commercial & marketing field.
• 4-6 years working experience in a similar role in FMCG sector.
• Strong analytical and project management skills and a feel for retail, sales, or marketing.
• You combine an analytical mind with creativity and present ideas clearly and convincingly.
• You speak French, Dutch & English.
• You are a sociable team player: flexible, driven, curious, and a strong communicator.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
• Knowledge of Nielsen is required.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Design Office - Dilbeek - Fast Growing Company
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian engineering group with offices located in the Dilbeek area, offering a modern and easily accessible work environment. You will join a structured technical department within a stable and growing industrial organisation.

Jobomschrijving

• Coach and develop a team of 10 technical specialists
• Organise and oversee the daily planning of the technical office
• Provide technical advice to clients, project managers and internal teams
• Prepare and validate cost calculations and technical quotations
• Analyse technical drawings, specifications and client requirements
• Manage client communication regarding ongoing orders and changes
• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

• Master's degree in civil engineering, architecture or a technical field
• Minimum 8 years of proven experience in a technical office environment
• Native Dutch speaker with good command of English and French
• Strong analytical mindset with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Initial experience in team management or coaching is required

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.
• Proven experience as a Project Engineer on industrial CAPEX projects, ideally in brownfield environments.
• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.

To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

Our client is an international engineering and project delivery organization managing complex EPC projects across industrial and infrastructure-related sectors.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities across Piping, Structures, Electrical, Instrumentation, HVAC/MEP, CAD, Construction, Procurement, suppliers, and offshore engineering teams.
• Develop and manage engineering schedules, deliverables, resources, engineering hours, budgets, and progress, using tools such as MS Project or equivalent.
• Lead technical coordination, interface management, design reviews, supplier technical discussions, and resolution of day-to-day engineering issues.
• Manage engineering risks, changes, technical clarifications, document control, and the complete deliverable cycle from IFR/IFD through IFC and as-built.
• Support constructibility, modularization, prefabrication, and site activities while ensuring the quality and integration of offshore engineering and CAD deliverables.

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Project Engineering Manager, Senior Project Engineer, or Project Manager within EPC projects, with experience on at least two relevant EPC projects.
• Strong multidisciplinary engineering background, with solid knowledge of Piping & Structures as well as Electrical & Instrumentation; construction/site experience is an advantage.
• Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, 3D models, CAD/BIM deliverables, specifications, datasheets, and calculation documentation.
• Experience with engineering planning and project tools such as MS Project, Primavera, Navisworks, or equivalent; knowledge of modularization and prefabrication is highly valued.
• Fluent English is mandatory; French is considered an advantage, with strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Lokeren, we are looking for a motivated Pallet Repair Worker to join a stable and growing company. You will work in a modern pallet repair line during the day shift, where quality, safety, and teamwork are essential.

Your responsibilities
	
• Repair damaged wooden pallets according to EPAL quality standards.	
• Use a pneumatic nail gun to attach boards and blocks.	
• Replace damaged pallet components, such as boards and blocks.	
• Inspect pallets for quality, dimensions, and compliance with EPAL standards.	
• Check chamfered edges and the overall condition of the pallets.	
• Sort pallets based on their condition and repair requirements.	
• Keep your workplace safe, clean, and well organized.	
• Work closely with your colleagues to ensure an efficient production process.

Who are we looking for?
	
• Experience in a production, woodworking, or logistics environment is an advantage, but motivated candidates willing to learn are also welcome.	
• You enjoy hands-on, physical work.	
• You work accurately and pay attention to quality and detail.	
• You can safely use hand tools and machinery.	
• You can work independently as well as in a team.	
• You have a good command of English to communicate on the work floor.	
• You are reliable, motivated, and responsible.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company based in Drongen, specializing in the production of high-quality coffins. To strengthen their production team, they are looking for a motivated Machine Operator (CNC Milling Machine) to join their permanent night shift.

Jobomschrijving

Your Responsibilities
	
• Operate a CNC milling/routing machine.	
• Monitor the production process and ensure smooth machine operation.	
• Perform quality checks on finished products.	
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.	
• Assist with material handling when required.

Your Profile
	
• Experience operating CNC machinery is an advantage.	
• Forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate is considered a strong plus.	
• You are willing to complete a training period of approximately 3 months in either the early or late shift before transitioning to the permanent night shift.	
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.	
• You are detail-oriented and committed to quality.	
• You are reliable and comfortable working in a production environment.

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area
? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).
• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.
• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.
• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.
• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.
• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.
• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.
• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.
• VCA certificate is an advantage.
• Category B driving licence.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.	
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.
